name: No More Thyme
source:
You had worked up the nerve to ascend the mountains hoping to find herbs to use in your cocktails for your bar. You had been craving a new hobby, so botany seemed efficient for your career, and your free time.

After stumbling about, you stop to see the mountain view, only to notice a  person! 

But you question it- 

How is there someone else here? 

This wasn’t a designated hiking path. 

Something didn’t feel quite right about this. Burly fellow.

Before you could fully assess your building tension, he interjects.

Sauntering over to you 

This tall stranger seems a little *too* eager to meet you. 

[From [url=https://nugnom.itch.io/no-more-thyme]Itch.io[/url]]
